class.name: SpotLight3D
class.brief_description: A light that shines from a point into a cone.
class.description: Adds range, cone angle, and fade settings to Light3D.

method.name: SetRange
method.description: Sets the light range value and updates the render light. Does not clamp the value.
method.param: The light range in world units. Use a positive value.

method.name: GetRange
method.returns: The light range in world units.

method.name: SetAttenuation
method.description: Sets the distance fade value sent to the render light. Does not clamp the value.
method.param: The setting for how the light fades with distance.

method.name: SetSpotAngle
method.description: Sets the cone angle value sent to the render light. Does not clamp the value.

method.name: GetSpotAngle
method.description: Gets the stored cone angle value.

method.name: SetSpotAttenuation
method.description: Sets the cone fade value sent to the render light. Does not clamp the value.
method.param: The setting for how the light fades toward the edge of the cone.
